summary: Stored procedure enters infinite loop after index updates, causing deadlocks and failed inserts.
symptoms: Locks on tables during update statements inside triggers
mechanism: Index page locking and trigger-induced locking during stored procedure execution.

facts.evidence: The stored procedure loops indefinitely after index updates.
Multiple triggers exist on the target tables.
Deleting an index resolved the issue, suggesting page locking.

assumptions: The infinite loop is caused by index page locking.
Triggers are contributing to locking during stored procedure execution.
unknowns: Exact index configuration before and after updates
